card.name: Spots before a capitalized proper name
card.fires_on: Small connecting spots in general web text right before a capitalized proper name is expected, such as the period after ST in saint lists, or words like at, the, by and notably before an institution or person.

modes.label: Saint abbreviation
modes.description: The period or ST in a numbered list of saints, right before the saint's name in capitals.
modes.example: 12. ST<<.>> MARTIN OF THE ASCENSION, born

modes.label: Link before an institution or person
modes.description: A small word such as at, the, by or notably that comes right before a named institution, group or person.
modes.example: professor emeritus of public policy and management at<< the>> Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania

modes.label: Digit in a URL
modes.description: A digit inside a web address date, before more text.

card.writes: It pushes toward name-like tokens such as Mark, Lord and Salv, and away from Chinese and Vietnamese name tokens.
card.plain: It fires on small words and punctuation that come just before a proper name, especially in lists of saints.
